name: fillers-en
_note: English preset for src/vtk/cuts.py (language 'en', see src/vtk/lang.py). Conservative like fillers-pt.json: a filler left in costs a 'cut' in edit.json during review; real content cut by mistake is easy to miss. 'fillers' = pure hesitation, always cut. Left out on purpose: 'ah'/'oh' (real interjections: 'Ah, I see'), 'er'/'err' ('ER' the emergency room, 'to err'), 'mm' ('5 mm'), and agreement sounds ('mm-hmm', 'uh-huh'; the engine also keeps 'mm hmm'). Add any of them to 'fillers' in edit.json for a speaker who uses them. 'extra_fillers' = crutch words, cut only next to a comma (before OR after); the engine cuts multi-word phrases ANYWHERE, so 'you know', 'I mean', 'kind of', 'sort of' can't go here ('do you know', 'what I mean is'). Only 'basically' is in: removing it never breaks the sentence. Left out: 'like' (', like emails' = such as), 'so' ('I think so, but'), 'actually' (a correction: 'No, actually, it's free'), 'right' ('Turn right,'; 'free, right?'), 'well' ('it works well, and'), 'okay', 'anyway', 'yeah', 'honestly', 'literally' (meaning or grammar depends on them). Cut them by hand in 'cut' when they are filler. 'short_words' = a caption line should not end on them; 'break_before' = breaking a caption line before them reads naturally; 'function_words' = language detection. Test: tests/test_fillers.py.
